side.name: Side
side.description: Which side of the anchor to position the menu against.

align.name: Align
align.description: How to align the menu along the side axis.

positionMethod.name: Position Method
positionMethod.description: The CSS positioning method to use for the positioner element.

sideOffset.name: Side Offset
sideOffset.description: Offset along the side axis in pixels.

alignOffset.name: Align Offset
alignOffset.description: Offset along the align axis in pixels.

arrowPadding.name: Arrow Padding
arrowPadding.description: Minimum padding between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

collisionPadding.name: Collision Padding
collisionPadding.description: Padding between the popup and the collision boundary.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.description: Whether the popup remains sticky to its side when it overflows the boundary.

disableAnchorTracking.name: Disable Anchor Tracking
disableAnchorTracking.description: Whether to disable tracking the anchor element's position.
